cases.description: Seven mappings and original ranges match baseline; no exposure aliases
All-zero and disabled recipes preserve uint8,uint16,float32,negative/HDR,signed zero bit-exact
Invalid fields, booleans, NaN/Inf, range, unknown schema and algorithm refuse without mutation
Brightness affects midtones but not black/white endpoints; whites/blacks affect distinct tonal tails
Constant field texture/clarity no change; fine and coarse spatial patterns respond separately
Step edges, ramps, skin pores, hair and noisy shadows: halos, gradient reversal and noise visual review
Negative/positive dehaze, uniform/colored haze, skies and HDR; no unwanted neutral color cast
Vibrance selective weaker on saturated colors; grayscale neutral; black-white profile suppresses effect without erasing saved value
Zero/one/soft masks exact blend; invalid shape/range fails; edges do not treat zero-mask boundary as image boundary
RGB16 sub8-bit distinctions retained; float32 HDR no normalization or output clipping
Preview scale vs 100% reference and assembled export boundary; no tile seams or per-tile haze variation
Exact request replay commits once; reused ID with changed request rejects; unknown receipt never auto-retries
Document switch during send/query never applies returned recipe to new photo
Frame/history failure restores recipe, frame, undo/redo, dirty flag; rollback failure reports unknown/reload
Undo/redo, device change, close/reopen, queued export restore identical complete recipe
Project and preset serialize version/algorithm/all controls; unsupported version refuses
Batch atomic group undo, rollback and per-image dehaze recomputation; no active-document leakage
UI repeated clicks, slider typing, cancel/reset, disabled/native missing, keyboard, remount, refresh and engine restart
Exact UI seven controls mount; handbook navigation routes reach active control, no fake disabled completion
24MP/100MP memory/admission, timing, cancellation and progress tested on target Linux CPU/GPU
Original-source license and installed ABI1 missing/mismatch packaging failures
Full original portrait/landscape scene set reviewed side-by-side; no visual acceptance from source-only tests
Project v16 roundtrip preserves v15 CUBE bytes and v14 hair; previous schema cannot carry hidden extended-tone recipe
Latest-intent/cancel before native, during bilateral, before publication, after publication; history/dirty rollback exact
Engine restart returns unknown, explicit readback shows current document/recipe, user acknowledgment clears only pending identity
Memory admission refusal before full-frame allocations, no reduced precision/proxy fallback; cooperative cancellation and progress
Full-frame exposure prepass and downstream override with LUT, levels, curves, local grades, sky, optics/crop and RGB16 preserve all effects
